title: Wintersun Skyrimnet Integration
tagline: Narrates your character's religious life and lets you converse with your deity during prayer.
description:
SkyrimNet integration for Wintersun - Faiths of Skyrim.

- **Prayer narration** - nearby NPCs hear a line when you kneel to pray
- **Shrine worship narration** - NPCs react when you worship at a shrine
- **Deity virtual NPC** - your deity becomes a conversation partner while you pray, with a unique voice and personality for all 52 deities
- **Shrine communion** - activating any shrine starts a brief conversation with that deity
- **Character bio submodule** - your deity and rank appear in your SkyrimNet character profile
- **World knowledge** - domain, tenets and boons for every deity

Settings are configurable in the SkyrimNet dashboard under the **Wintersun Integration** plugin.
author: oldcustard
